method.description: Coming Soon is a film-level Seattle theatrical calendar over a 90-day Pacific-local window. Four independent evidence facts are tracked: AMC Coming Soon catalog membership (national), Seattle-area AMC theater bookings, TMDB US theatrical releases, and published Reel Seattle showtimes. classification remains pipeline/source state; relevance_tier and in_recommended drive the curated Recommended list (confirmed_local, locally_announced, strongly_expected). The public artifact also ships a broader All releases film-calendar slice (weak_national_only / below-popularity AMC∩TMDB) while TMDB-only, special-programming, and local repertory/series stay analysis-only. Confirmed local bookings are classified as release-like vs local programming; ambiguous niche Seattle openings are retained without a TMDB popularity gate. strongly_expected requires AMC catalog ∩ TMDB US theatrical plus TMDB popularity at/above the configured floor. Engagement SKUs (Q&A, Fan First, Early Access, Fan Event) consolidate under the parent film.

He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.

presentation.overview: For more than 25 years, the designers behind the avant-garde fashion collective threeASFOUR-- Gabi Asfour (Lebanese-Palestinian), Angela Donhauser (German-Tajikistani), and Adi Gil (Israeli) -- have created clothing with uncompromising vision. Drawing inspiration from natural forms and pioneering techniques, they have continually pushed the boundaries of what fashion can be, earning them a cult following, global museum exhibitions, and fans like Bjork and Chloe Sevigny. Yet behind the acclaim lies an ongoing challenge to survive in an industry driven by commerce. The film is a moving portrait of three iconoclasts daring to center creativity and cross-cultural collaboration over money and profit.

presentation.overview: Intrigue, corruption, betrayal, survival: the walls of the maze are closing in. The latest from Academy Award nominated writer-director Andrey Zvyagintsev (Loveless, Leviathan), Cannes Grand Prix winner MINOTAUR is a twist-laden parable for our times. Russia, 2022. Amidst the comfortable trappings of affluence and domesticity, corporate executive Gleb (Dmitriy Mazurov) finds himself under siege on all fronts. At home, he is haunted by suspicions that his increasingly distant wife Galina (Iris Lebedeva) is unfaithful. At work, he contends with a demand from local authorities to draft a quota of employees for the war in Ukraine. Desperate to keep his hands clean, Gleb struggles to reassert control even as the collapse of his carefully ordered life seems fated to accelerate toward violence. A pressure cooker in cinematic form, MINOTAUR uncovers and indicts the heart of societal darkness with searing clarity. Uniting intimately-drawn performances and stark visual power, this is peerless work from an indisputable master.

presentation.overview: Chakven is the story of a respected Punjabi village family known for its values, love, and loyalty across generations. The family is still dealing with the loss of their eldest son, Guri, who lost his life due to political rivalries. His best friend, Sukha (Kartar Cheema), returns home after serving seven years in prison following the same incident. Sukha has always treated Guri?s younger brother, Jassa (Vishal Brar), as his own brother. After spending years behind bars, Sukha now dreams of leaving his past behind and starting a new life in Canada. Jassa, once a hot-tempered young man involved in village politics and conflicts, decides to change his ways for the sake of his family. Like many Punjabi families hoping for a better future abroad, Jassa sends his newlywed wife, Ravi, to Canada. Sukha also eventually moves to Canada, leaving Jassa alone in Punjab to look after his family, home, and responsibilities.    As time passes, the struggles of student life in Canada and the distance between Jassa and Ravi begin to affect their relationship. Two years later, Jassa receives shocking news that Ravi has become involved in the escort business. Unable to accept what he has heard, Jassa?s old temper returns, and he decides to travel to Canada to find out the truth and confront his wife. Things become even more complicated because Sukha, who has always considered Ravi his own sister, finds himself caught in the middle of the situation. With Jassa?s anger, Sukha?s loyalty, and Ravi?s unexpected circumstances, the story takes a series of emotional, humorous, and unpredictable turns. Chakven is a Punjabi family entertainer that brings together friendship, brotherhood, relationships, emotions, and situational comedy, set against the changing lives of Punjabi families between Punjab and Canada.

presentation.overview:
First released in 1985, RATE IT X stunned audiences and critics alike with its unflinching look at how sexism and sexual exploitation are embedded in American media and culture. Directors Lucy Winer and Paula de Koenigsberg traveled across the United States interviewing men who profited from--and helped perpetuate--stereotyped and sexualized images of women. Advertising executives describe how sex is used to sell products. Hustler magazine's creator of the notorious 'Chester the Molester' cartoon proudly displays drawings depicting a predatory adult man entrapping young girls. A fundamentalist minister tells us that Adam shirked his responsibility by allowing Eve to lead. The flamboyant producer of a popular cable show roams the streets of New York City in a silver lame jumpsuit, video camera in hand, asking young women, "Would you like to flex into a hallway and pose nude?"

Applauded for its keen humor, Rate It X is now digitally restored and rereleased, remaining as provocative and relevant as ever. Despite decades of hard-fought victories in the women's movement, women's rights continue to face renewed challenges, and many of the cultural attitudes the film exposes remain deeply embedded. At a moment when political battles over sex discrimination and civil liberties intensify, the film's confrontational lens feels newly urgent. As public demands grow for greater transparency and accountability surrounding the sexual abuse and exploitation of minors, RATE IT X stands as a powerful reminder of why exposing these dynamics--and questioning the culture that sustains them--remains essential.

entries.title: The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth

presentation.overview: Murder, blackmail, theft, extortion — just another summer in Hollywood. It’s 1977, eight years since Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) encountered the Manson family in Quentin Tarantino’s parallel history of 1969, Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood. In THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH, directed by David Fincher from a new script by Tarantino, the fairytale is over. Los Angeles no longer needs a hippie-slaying stuntman the way it did. But Hollywood will always have problems, problems that can only be solved by someone with Cliff’s unique (occasionally extralegal) abilities. When he’s not earning his keep bartending or as a projectionist, Cliff Booth is a fixer — solving situations for Hollywood’s great and, sometimes, not so good. He’s curious when he gets a call from talent agent Karen Crosby (Elizabeth Debicki), on behalf of her client, TV megastar Charlie Peters (Scott Caan) — a man known for doing his own stunts. And he’s further entertained and intrigued when he meets other characters in Charlie’s world, from his knowing wife Toni (Carla Gugino) to pro football champion turned screen star Roderick “Hot Rod” Harrison (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II). Then there are the Verdusco brothers (Matt Groove and JB Tadena), mysterious gangsters causing mayhem across the city. What was once a fairytale is now a crime story — a cocktail of violence, ambition, and desire that could only happen in LA. Discover whether the further adventures — or mis-adventures — of Cliff Booth end happily ever after on November 25 in IMAX at AMC.

entries.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon

presentation.overview: At just 16 years old, strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator Soraya Akhlaghi has spent five years trying to find a way out of Iran and join her mother in Europe. Trapped in a marriage to a violent man, Soraya escapes the brutality and isolation of her daily life through art, channeling all her worries, joys, and fears into stunning drawings and sculptures. Many of her creations feature recurring figures: a clown who never laughs, a pink moon that always watches over her, and a fox who is her loyal travel companion. Crafted from years of Soraya's own cell phone footage and video calls with co-director Mehrdad Oskouei, this textured self-portrait interweaves Soraya's artwork with riveting scenes of her escape attempts, political news from Afghanistan, and videos where she sings, dances, or defiantly shows her bruises. A diary, a survival story, and an artistic manifesto, A Fox Under a Pink Moon is an unforgettable testament to the creative resilience of a 16-year-old girl who refuses to be reduced to her circumstances. Winner of over 30 prizes at major festivals around the world, including Best Documentary at IDFA and Full Frame.

If you're nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you're naughty, you get justice.

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North--the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise--and returning action director Tommy Wirkola.

In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall.

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). 

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2).

VIOLENT NIGHT 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film's returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.

Winner of the U.S. Documentary Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival and hailed by Werner Herzog as 'truly groundbreaking', NUISANCE BEAR places viewers inside the world of a polar bear to deliver a cinematic pressure cooker and an urgent parable for our times. 

Filmmakers Gabriela Osio Vanden and Jack Weisman follow a polar bear in Churchill, Manitoba -- the self-styled 'Polar Bear Capital of the World' -- forced to navigate tourists, wildlife officers and hunters as climate change pushes it into town.
  
Guided by Inuit narrator Mike Tunalaaq Gibbons, whose perspective resists simplification, Nuisance Bear overturns the conventions of the nature documentary to ask: when a sacred predator is branded a 'nuisance,' who truly belongs in this shared landscape?

Young undercover cop Billy Costigan (Leonardo DiCaprio) is assigned to infiltrate the mob syndicate run by gangland chief Costello (Jack Nicholson).   While Billy is quickly gaining Costello's confidence, Colin Sullivan (Matt Damon), a hardened young criminal who has infiltrated the police department as an informer for the syndicate, is rising to a position of power in the Special Investigation Unit.  Each man becomes deeply consumed by his double life, gathering information about the plans and counter-plans of the operations he has penetrated.  But when it becomes clear to both the gangsters and the police that there's a mole in their midst, Billy and Colin are suddenly in danger of being caught and exposed to the enemy - and each must race to uncover the identity of the other man in time to save himself.

In 1974, the New York City music scene was shocked into consciousness by the violently new and raw sound of a band of misfits from Queens called The Ramones. Playing in a seedy Bowery bar to a small group of fellow struggling musicians, the band struck a chord of disharmony that rocked the foundation of the mid-seventies music scene. This quartet of unlikely rock stars traveled across the country and around the world connecting with the disenfranchised everywhere, while sparking a movement that would resonate with two generations of outcasts across the globe. Although the band never reached the top of the Billboard charts, they managed to endure by maintaining a rigorous touring schedule for twenty-two years. 4K Re-release.

Pierre arrives at the front lines as a young soldier eager to find his footing in a world consumed by violence. Everything changes when he meets Francis, a kindred spirit whose vision of staging a front-line theater show unlocks a world Pierre never knew existed. What begins as a fleeting escape from the harsh reality of the trenches soon blossoms into a tender, emotional love story, anchored by the undeniable chemistry of breakout actors Emmanuel Macchia and Valentin Campagne. As the world burns around them, their stage becomes a sanctuary of innocence and devotion. COWARD beautifully explores the fine line between fear and fortitude for soldiers in search of a promised glory, ultimately asking: when the world demands brutality, is walking away for love the truest act of bravery?

When her artwork is surpassed by her reclusive peer Kyomoto, she becomes obsessed with honing her skills, eventually burning out and giving up drawing altogether. But when Fujino finally meets Kyomoto, she discovers that Kyomoto has been her devoted fan all along. Bound by their shared passion, they spend irreplaceable years drawing manga together until a fateful event changes their lives forever.

From Palme d'Or winner Hirokazu Koreeda, Look Back is a love letter to the artistic process, hand-written in ink on paper, and a meditation on how mutual pursuit of a craft creates the deepest etches in our memory.

presentation.overview:
The sun is down.  The boat is dead.  There's no cell service.  And there's someone standing, staring, from both shores.  Written and directed by Joshua Giuliano, RIVER stars Jane Levy (Evil Dead), Jessica Rothe (Happy Death Day) and Max Mattern (Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy) as three estranged siblings who reunite in their hometown after the death of their father. As they set out to scatter his ashes at his favorite spot on a remote river, the trip devolves into a waking nightmare. Dane DiLiegro (Prey) also stars in the film.

Currently with a 94% critics rating on Rotten Tomatoes, RIVER was acquired by Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster following an electrifying launch at Midnight Madness at the Toronto International Film Festival. This release establishes a meaningful, new collaboration between Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster, Independent Film Company and Shudder, bringing them together for the expanded theatrical release of Joshua Giuliano's debut feature. 

Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Independent Film Company present RIVER, a Shudder Original Production, in association with Upgrade. RIVER is produced by Spooky Pictures' Steven Schneider and Eat the Cat's Nick Antosca and Alex Hedlund. The film is executive produced by Allegheny Image Factory's Jeffrey Tinnell and Robert Tinnell, Upgrade's Matt Brodlie and Jonathan Kier, Ben Ross and Blumhouse Atomic Monster's Jason Blum.

Pierre-Auguste Renoir is one of the world's favourite artists; a founding member of the Impressionist movement and a constantly evolving artist, he is unmatched at depicting human connection. The National Gallery's blockbuster exhibition brings together vibrant masterpieces which explore love in all its forms, bringing colour and warmth into the cold winter months.

With exclusive access to this exciting new show, Exhibition on Screen will bring these world class works to cinema audiences, with close examination of the art and leading experts exploring the immense skill and influence of this master of colour and connection. Be transported back to a Parisian summer of love through the eyes of a true visionary. An unmissable opportunity to fall in love with Renoir this winter.

From the vibrant energy of Delhi to the sacred banks of the Ganges, and on to the breathtaking panoramas of the Himalayas, they reveal an India that is both vibrant and profoundly human. Amidst flamboyant colors, age-old traditions, and the seething energy of the streets, the journey also offers moments of tranquility and pure emotion. Enchanting ceremonies, unforgettable encounters, majestic temples, and authentic scenes of daily life: this new film invites you to see, feel, and experience India? in a new way.

The film, about a country western star in free fall, is set to star Glen Powell and Cristin Milioti. Judd Apatow will direct. Apatow and Powell wrote the script together.

Apatow will produce through his longstanding Apatow Productions overall deal with the Studio. Apatow's relationship with the Studio dates back to his 2005 directorial debut, The 40-Year-Old Virgin, and he has since directed Knocked Up, Funny People, This is 40, Trainwreck and The King of Staten Island for the Studio.

Powell and Dan Cohen will produce through Barnstorm's first look deal with the Studio. Powell's relationship with the Studio originates with his starring role in Twisters, which overperformed against all industry expectations, becoming the biggest opening for a natural disaster film ever at the domestic box office and grossing $267.8 million overall in the domestic box office.

Kevin Misher will produce through Misher Films. Misher has a storied history with Universal Pictures, where he was President of Production from 1996-2001 and supervised production for some of the Studio's most acclaimed features, including Erin Brockovich, The Fast and the Furious, Meet the Parents, and The Mummy. Misher subsequently formed Misher Films, where he has been producing a variety of films over the past two decades, including Fighting With My Family, Coming 2 America and You People.
